title: "AI Governance in Finance: Models & Key Insights"
description: The article examines the critical role of AI governance models in ensuring ethical, secure, and effective AI deployment within the financial services industry. It highlights four governance approaches—centralized, decentralized, hybrid, and third-party—while detailing key factors such as regulatory compliance, transparency, risk management, ethical practices, and ongoing monitoring.
